configurations.name: inspecto-bundle
runtimeArgs: node tools\seed-samples.mjs --all && cd inspecto-deploy && set PORT=%PORT% && set CONTROL_TOKEN=devtoken && call .\serve.bat

configurations.name: inspecto-demo-spaces
runtimeArgs: cd inspecto-demo && set PORT=%PORT% && set SPACES_ROOT=..\spaces && call .\serve-demo.bat

configurations.name: inspecto-la-app
runtimeArgs: node tools\seed-la-showcase.mjs --scaffold inspecto-demo\spaces-la-showcase && cd inspecto-demo && set PORT=%PORT% && set SPACES_ROOT=spaces-la-showcase && call .\serve-demo.bat

configurations.name: inspecto-personal
runtimeArgs: cd inspecto-deploy && set PORT=%PORT% && set CONTROL_TOKEN=devtoken && call .\serve.bat
